topic: stop a shoe insole from sliding around
core_question: How do I keep a shoe insole from shifting and bunching up inside the shoe? (secondary: How do I calculate my personal net worth?)
answer_summary: Apply a thin bead of fabric/shoe glue or a strip of double-sided tape to the underside of the insole and press it firmly into the shoe bed to keep it from sliding.; after the topic shift: List the current value of everything you own (cash, investments, property) as assets, list everything you owe (loans, credit card balances) as liabilities, and subtract total liabilities from total assets to get net worth.
